primary_direction.title: Developmental Canalization and Context Expression Model
primary_direction.root_mechanism: A distributed polygenic and rare-variant liability influences neurodevelopmental lateralization; early developmental conditions shape the latent motor state; task and cultural environments transform that state into preference, performance, and writing-hand phenotypes.
primary_direction.intervention_type: longitudinal observational multimodal study with preregistered causal-structure tests
falsifiable_conditions: Early latent lateralization does not predict later phenotype out of sample.
Genetic terms fail replication or add no variance after developmental and family covariates.
Culture shifts performance as much as preference, contradicting the expression-layer prediction.
Brain-asymmetry mediation fails across sessions or populations.
primary_direction.feasibility: high for existing-cohort harmonization and non-invasive follow-up; moderate for new longitudinal imaging and rare-variant sampling

competitive_directions.title: Expanded association scan for handedness
competitive_directions.reason: strong for locus discovery but insufficient for developmental directionality and environment

competitive_directions.title: Single-region cortical localization
competitive_directions.reason: distributed and heterogeneous imaging evidence cannot support one location

competitive_directions.title: Task instruction and cultural pressure model
competitive_directions.reason: explains expression and forced switching but not inherited developmental liability

competitive_directions.title: Frequency-dependent population model
competitive_directions.reason: addresses majority stability but needs individual developmental mediators

rejected_directions.reason: incompatible with polygenic GWAS, small rare-variant contribution, and twin evidence
unfalsifiable as a universal localization claim and inconsistent with distributed brain asymmetry

evolution_checkpoints.change: binary right-versus-left phenotype -> preference, performance, writing-hand, and latent-state decomposition
evolution_checkpoints.reason: addresses G1 and prevents measurement conflation

evolution_checkpoints.change: locus list -> polygenic and rare-variant developmental liability
evolution_checkpoints.reason: aligns with E2, E4, and E8 and addresses G2-G3

evolution_checkpoints.change: culture as competing explanation -> context expression moderator
evolution_checkpoints.reason: tests whether environment changes latent performance or only reported preference and addresses G5-G7
